name: zsnd_apply_mute_state_to_active_voices
description: zSnd::ApplyMuteStateToActiveVoices updates nested mute depth and the live mute option, snapshots active voices, rewrites DirectSound volumes or A3D gains for the new mute state, and returns the previous muted state.
known_limits: Binary Ninja reconstruction is limited around circular-list tests and DirectSound vtable slot naming, but assembly identifies the DirectSound SetVolume and A3D SetGain dispatches.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSound playback helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a0670 validates the initialization guard, previous mute-state return, mute-depth increment/decrement, mute option writeback, active-sample snapshot creation, DirectSound SetVolume(-10000 or gainScaled), and A3D SetGain(0.0 or replay gain) backend branches.

The native smoke verifies uninitialized no-op behavior, DirectSound mute and unmute volume writes, A3D mute and unmute gain writes, mute-depth updates, live mute option updates, and previous-state return values.
